text: 甲：Jia；拼音 jiǎ；五行 wood；阴阳 yang；Yang Wood — a towering tree; growth, initiative and uprightness.
乙：Yi；拼音 yǐ；五行 wood；阴阳 yin；Yin Wood — flowering plants and vines; flexibility and adaptability.
丙：Bing；拼音 bǐng；五行 fire；阴阳 yang；Yang Fire — the sun; brightness, generosity and visibility.
丁：Ding；拼音 dīng；五行 fire；阴阳 yin；Yin Fire — a candle or lamp flame; focus, warmth and refinement.
戊：Wu；拼音 wù；五行 earth；阴阳 yang；Yang Earth — a mountain or city wall; stability and reliability.
己：Ji；拼音 jǐ；五行 earth；阴阳 yin；Yin Earth — garden soil; nourishment, patience and practicality.
庚：Geng；拼音 gēng；五行 metal；阴阳 yang；Yang Metal — a sword or axe; decisiveness, justice and resolve.
辛：Xin；拼音 xīn；五行 metal；阴阳 yin；Yin Metal — jewelry and fine ornaments; precision, elegance and sensitivity.
壬：Ren；拼音 rén；五行 water；阴阳 yang；Yang Water — the ocean or a great river; movement, ambition and resourcefulness.
癸：Gui；拼音 guǐ；五行 water；阴阳 yin；Yin Water — rain, dew and springs; intuition, gentleness and permeation.
子：Zi；拼音 zǐ；五行 water；Rat branch — cardinal Water; midnight, winter solstice, hidden beginnings.
丑：Chou；拼音 chǒu；五行 earth；Ox branch — moist Earth; late winter, quiet accumulation.
寅：Yin；拼音 yín；五行 wood；Tiger branch — Yang Wood; early spring, the start of the zodiac year.
卯：Mao；拼音 mǎo；五行 wood；Rabbit branch — Yin Wood; mid-spring, sunrise and expansion.
辰：Chen；拼音 chén；五行 earth；Dragon branch — wet Earth; late spring, the water reservoir.
巳：Si；拼音 sì；五行 fire；Snake branch — Yin Fire; early summer, hidden heat.
午：Wu；拼音 wǔ；五行 fire；Horse branch — cardinal Fire; noon, summer solstice, peak Yang.
未：Wei；拼音 wèi；五行 earth；Goat branch — dry Earth; late summer, the wood reservoir.
申：Shen；拼音 shēn；五行 metal；Monkey branch — Yang Metal; early autumn, the water birthplace.
酉：You；拼音 yǒu；五行 metal；Rooster branch — cardinal Metal; mid-autumn, sunset and precision.
戌：Xu；拼音 xū；五行 earth；Dog branch — dry Earth; late autumn, the fire reservoir.
亥：Hai；拼音 hài；五行 water；Pig branch — Yang Water; early winter, the wood birthplace.
木：Wood；拼音 mù；Growth, expansion and benevolence; associated with spring and the east.
火：Fire；拼音 huǒ；Heat, illumination and propriety; associated with summer and the south.
土：Earth；拼音 tǔ；Stability, nourishment and trust; associated with the late-season transitions and the center.
金：Metal；拼音 jīn；Structure, decisiveness and righteousness; associated with autumn and the west.
水：Water；拼音 shuǐ；Flow, wisdom and adaptability; associated with winter and the north.
比肩：Friend；拼音 bǐ jiān；Same element, same polarity as the Day Master: peers, siblings, competitors and self-reliance.
劫财：Rob Wealth；拼音 jié cái；Same element, opposite polarity: rivals who share your resources; boldness and spending.
食神：Eating God；拼音 shí shén；Element the Day Master generates, same polarity: creativity, enjoyment, expression and fertility.
伤官：Hurting Officer；拼音 shāng guān；Element the Day Master generates, opposite polarity: talent, rebellion and rule-breaking brilliance.
偏财：Indirect Wealth；拼音 piān cái；Element the Day Master controls, same polarity: windfall money, business acumen and generosity.
正财：Direct Wealth；拼音 zhèng cái；Element the Day Master controls, opposite polarity: stable income, savings and (traditionally) the wife star.
七杀：Seven Killings；拼音 qī shā；Element that controls the Day Master, same polarity: pressure, authority, courage and fierce ambition.
正官：Direct Officer；拼音 zhèng guān；Element that controls the Day Master, opposite polarity: career, discipline, reputation and (traditionally) the husband star.
偏印：Indirect Resource；拼音 piān yìn；Element that generates the Day Master, same polarity: unconventional learning, intuition and solitude.
正印：Direct Resource；拼音 zhèng yìn；Element that generates the Day Master, opposite polarity: education, protection, motherly support and credentials.
日主：Day Master；拼音 rì zhǔ；The Heavenly Stem of the Day Pillar — the reference point of the whole chart, representing the self.
长生：Birth；拼音 cháng shēng；Newly born energy; the element enters its most promising phase.
沐浴：Bathing；拼音 mù yù；Infancy and washing; vulnerable, romantic and unstable energy.
冠带：Crowning；拼音 guàn dài；Coming of age; the element dresses up and starts to show capability.
临官：Officiating；拼音 lín guān；Taking office; mature, productive energy approaching its peak.
帝旺：Peak；拼音 dì wàng；Imperial prosperity; the element at maximum strength.
衰：Decline；拼音 shuāi；Energy past its prime, gradually weakening.
病：Illness；拼音 bìng；Weakened energy, like sickness; low vitality.
死：Death；拼音 sǐ；Dormant energy; quiet, still and inactive.
墓：Tomb；拼音 mù；Stored energy locked in the tomb; latent, hoarded, awaiting a key.
绝：Extinction；拼音 jué；The lowest point; energy seemingly gone but about to turn.
胎：Gestation；拼音 tāi；Conception; a new cycle forming in secret.
养：Nurturing；拼音 yǎng；Nourishment before birth; gentle preparation for the next cycle.
天乙贵人：Heavenly Nobleman；拼音 tiān yǐ guì rén；The most auspicious star: helpful people and timely rescue in difficulty.
太极贵人：Taiji Nobleman；拼音 tài jí guì rén；Affinity with metaphysics, philosophy and deep research.
天德贵人：Heavenly Virtue；拼音 tiān dé guì rén；Heaven-sent protection that softens disasters.
月德贵人：Monthly Virtue；拼音 yuè dé guì rén；Gentle protective virtue; calming influence on misfortune.
天德合：Heavenly Virtue Union；拼音 tiān dé hé；Companion star of Heavenly Virtue; reinforces protection.
月德合：Monthly Virtue Union；拼音 yuè dé hé；Companion star of Monthly Virtue; reinforces protection.
德秀贵人：Virtue-Elegance Nobleman；拼音 dé xiù guì rén；Refined character and talent; turns danger into fortune.
福星贵人：Blessing Nobleman；拼音 fú xīng guì rén；Everyday blessings, comfort and a smooth life path.
文昌贵人：Literary Star；拼音 wén chāng guì rén；Academic success, writing talent and examination luck.
学堂：School Hall；拼音 xué táng；Scholarly star favoring study and intellectual growth.
词馆：Literary Bureau；拼音 cí guǎn；Eloquence and literary accomplishment.
天医：Heavenly Doctor；拼音 tiān yī；Affinity with medicine, healing and health work.
驿马：Traveling Horse；拼音 yì mǎ；Movement: travel, relocation, overseas ties and restless change.
桃花：Peach Blossom；拼音 táo huā；Romance, charm and social magnetism.
红艳：Red Beauty；拼音 hóng yàn；Intense romantic allure; passion that can outshine caution.
红鸾：Red Phoenix；拼音 hóng luán；Marriage and celebration star; joyous occasions.
天喜：Heavenly Joy；拼音 tiān xǐ；Happiness, weddings and festive events.
华盖：Elegant Canopy；拼音 huá gài；Artistic genius and spiritual depth, tinged with solitude.
金舆：Golden Carriage；拼音 jīn yú；Comfort, spousal support and an easy ride through life.
将星：General Star；拼音 jiàng xīng；Leadership, authority and command over others.
羊刃：Blade；拼音 yáng rèn；Sharp, aggressive edge just past the peak; courage mixed with risk of injury.
飞刃：Flying Blade；拼音 fēi rèn；The opposite-facing blade; sudden conflicts and impulsive force.
禄神：Prosperity Star；拼音 lù shén；Steady income and self-earned wealth; the stem at its own root.
流霞：Flowing Mist；拼音 liú xiá；Blood-related caution star; watch for injuries and inflammation.
孤辰：Solitary Star；拼音 gū chén；Emotional distance and preference for solitude.
寡宿：Widowed Star；拼音 guǎ sù；Loneliness in close relationships; inner detachment.
劫煞：Robbery Star；拼音 jié shà；Sudden loss or seizure; act with caution in risky matters.
灾煞：Disaster Star；拼音 zāi shà；External misfortune; traditionally linked to accidents and setbacks.
亡神：Lost Spirit；拼音 wáng shén；Hidden schemes and mental drain; can sharpen strategy when controlled.
披麻：Mourning Veil；拼音 pī má；Family worries and melancholy events.
童子煞：Child Star；拼音 tóng zǐ shà；Folk belief of a celestial child identity; a youthful, otherworldly temperament.
六秀日：Six Elegance Day；拼音 liù xiù rì；Day pillar known for talent and refined appearance.
九丑日：Nine Ugly Day；拼音 jiǔ chǒu rì；Day pillar linked to romantic entanglements; name misleads, effect is relational friction.
空亡：Void；拼音 kōng wáng；The two branches outside the current decade cycle; energy that feels hollow or deferred.
国印：State Seal；拼音 guó yìn；Officialdom, seals of office and institutional power.
天罗地网：Sky Net & Earth Net；拼音 tiān luó dì wǎng；Confining combinations (戌亥 / 辰巳) that feel like being trapped.
阴差阳错：Yin-Yang Mismatch；拼音 yīn chā yáng cuò；Day pillar linked to misunderstandings in family and marriage matters.
十恶大败：Ten Evils Great Defeat；拼音 shí è dà bài；Classic inauspicious day pillar group; tradition advises careful money management.
海中金：Sea Gold；Gold hidden in the sea: talent waiting to be discovered.
炉中火：Furnace Fire；Fire in the furnace: energy that forges and transforms.
大林木：Forest Wood；Great forest wood: abundant, sheltering growth.
路旁土：Roadside Earth；Earth by the roadside: practical, trodden, serviceable.
剑锋金：Sword-edge Gold；Sharpened blade metal: precision and cutting brilliance.
山头火：Mountaintop Fire；Fire on the summit: visible, far-reaching light.
涧下水：Stream Water；Water in the ravine: clear, quiet, persistent flow.
城头土：City-wall Earth；Rampart earth: defensive strength and boundaries.
白蜡金：Wax Gold；White wax metal: formable value needing refinement.
杨柳木：Willow Wood；Willow wood: graceful flexibility and resilience.
泉中水：Spring Water；Water in the well: inexhaustible, hidden source.
屋上土：Rooftop Earth；Earth on the roof: shelter and protection.
霹雳火：Thunderbolt Fire；Lightning fire: sudden, dramatic power.
松柏木：Pine Wood；Pine and cypress: endurance through seasons.
长流水：Long-flowing Water；Ever-flowing water: momentum that never stagnates.
沙中金：Sand Gold；Gold in sand: value requiring patient sifting.
山下火：Foothill Fire；Fire below the mountain: warmth close to home.
平地木：Plain Wood；Wood on the plain: steady, unpretentious growth.
壁上土：Wall Earth；Earth on the wall: quiet support and structure.
金箔金：Gold Foil；Gilt foil: beauty, ornament and surface brilliance.
覆灯火：Lamp Fire；Covered lamp flame: small light that guides in darkness.
天河水：River of Heaven Water；Celestial river: the Milky Way; inspiration from above.
大驿土：Highway Earth；Great post-road earth: connection, travel and commerce.
钗钏金：Hairpin Gold；Ornamental jewelry metal: adornment and refined value.
桑柘木：Mulberry Wood；Mulberry wood: cultivation, silkworms and useful craft.
大溪水：Great Stream Water；Rushing stream: vigorous, purposeful movement.
沙中土：Desert Earth；Earth in sand: loose foundation needing consolidation.
天上火：Celestial Fire；Fire in the sky: the sun itself; universal warmth.
石榴木：Pomegranate Wood；Pomegranate wood: hard wood bearing many fruits.
大海水：Ocean Water；The open ocean: vastness, depth and inclusiveness.
八字：BaZi (Four Pillars)；拼音 bā zì；The Eight Characters: a destiny chart built from the year, month, day and hour of birth.
四柱：Four Pillars；拼音 sì zhù；The four stem-branch pairs — year, month, day and hour — that make up a chart.
年柱：Year Pillar；拼音 nián zhù；The first pillar; roots, ancestry and early life.
月柱：Month Pillar；拼音 yuè zhù；The second pillar; parents, career environment and youth.
日柱：Day Pillar；拼音 rì zhù；The third pillar; the self (stem) and the spouse palace (branch).
时柱：Hour Pillar；拼音 shí zhù；The fourth pillar; children, later life and ambitions.
天干：Heavenly Stem；拼音 tiān gān；One of ten yang/yin symbols; the visible, active layer of a pillar.
地支：Earthly Branch；拼音 dì zhī；One of twelve symbols (the zodiac animals); the hidden, receptive layer of a pillar.
干支：Stem-Branch (GanZhi)；拼音 gān zhī；A stem paired with a branch; one unit of the sexagenary cycle.
藏干：Hidden Stems；拼音 cáng gān；The stems concealed inside each branch, giving it layered meaning.
大运：Luck Pillar；拼音 dà yùn；A ten-year fortune cycle overlaid on the natal chart.
流年：Annual Fortune；拼音 liú nián；The influence of a specific calendar year on the chart.
小运：Minor Cycle；拼音 xiǎo yùn；A one-year cycle used before the first Luck Pillar begins.
起运：Luck Onset；拼音 qǐ yùn；The age at which the first Luck Pillar cycle starts.
命宫：Life Palace；拼音 mìng gōng；An auxiliary pillar describing the core life theme.
身宫：Body Palace；拼音 shēn gōng；An auxiliary pillar describing how life is lived out in practice.
胎元：Conception Pillar；拼音 tāi yuán；The stem-branch of conception; inherited and prenatal influence.
胎息：Prenatal Breath；拼音 tāi xī；A pillar paired with the Conception Pillar; subtle life force.
阴阳：Yin & Yang；拼音 yīn yáng；The two complementary polarities underlying every stem and branch.
五行：Five Elements；拼音 wǔ xíng；Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water — the phases of transforming energy.
十神：Ten Gods；拼音 shí shén；Relationship labels between each stem and the Day Master.
神煞：Shen Sha (Symbolic Stars)；拼音 shén shà；Auspicious and inauspicious symbolic stars overlaid on the chart.
纳音：Na Yin (Melodic Element)；拼音 nà yīn；The thirty melodic elements assigned to each stem-branch pair.
刑冲合会：Interactions；拼音 xíng chōng hé huì；The clashes, combinations, punishments, harms and destructions between stems and branches.
生肖：Chinese Zodiac；拼音 shēng xiào；The twelve animals mapped to the Earthly Branches.
旬：Decade (Xun)；拼音 xún；A ten-day group of the sexagenary cycle; determines the void branches.
星运：Growth Stage；拼音 xīng yùn；One of the twelve lifecycle stages of an element across the branches.
自坐：Self-sitting；拼音 zì zuò；The branch directly beneath the Day Stem and the ten god it forms.
五行分值：Element Score；拼音 wǔ xíng fēn zhí；Weighted strength of each of the Five Elements in the chart.
主星：Main Star；拼音 zhǔ xīng；The primary ten god of a pillar (usually its hidden main stem).
副星：Secondary Star；拼音 fù xīng；The additional ten gods contributed by other hidden stems.
日主五行：Day Master Element；拼音 rì zhǔ wǔ xíng；The Five Element of the Day Stem — the self element of the chart.
真太阳时：True Solar Time；拼音 zhēn tài yáng shí；Local apparent solar time, corrected for longitude and season; the basis of the Hour Pillar.
时辰：Double-hour；拼音 shí chén；A traditional two-hour period; twelve of them span a day.
农历：Lunar Calendar；拼音 nóng lì；The traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar.
公历：Gregorian Calendar；拼音 gōng lì；The international solar calendar.
性别：Gender；拼音 xìng bié；Male or female; determines the direction of the Luck Pillar cycles.
男：Male；Male gender input for chart calculation.
女：Female；Female gender input for chart calculation.
顺行：Forward；拼音 shùn xíng；Luck Pillars advancing in the natural cycle order.
逆行：Backward；拼音 nì xíng；Luck Pillars advancing in the reverse cycle order.
当前：Current；拼音 dāng qián；Marks the Luck Pillar or year that is active now.
天干五合：Stem Combination；拼音 tiān gān wǔ hé；Five Heavenly Stem pairings that bond and may transform: 甲己, 乙庚, 丙辛, 丁壬, 戊癸.
六合：Six Harmony；拼音 liù hé；Six branch pairings of mutual affinity and support: 子丑, 寅亥, 卯戌, 辰酉, 巳申, 午未.
三合：Three Harmony；拼音 sān hé；Triads that combine into one element: 申子辰(water), 亥卯未(wood), 寅午戌(fire), 巳酉丑(metal).
三会：Directional Combination；拼音 sān huì；Three adjacent branches of one seasonal direction: 寅卯辰(east), 巳午未(south), 申酉戌(west), 亥子丑(north).
六冲：Clash；拼音 liù chōng；Six opposing branch pairings that collide and disrupt: 子午, 丑未, 寅申, 卯酉, 辰戌, 巳亥.
相刑：Punishment；拼音 xiāng xíng；Branch punishments that grind and injure: 寅巳申, 丑戌未, 子卯, and the self-punishments 辰/午/酉/亥.
相害：Harm；拼音 xiāng hài；Six branch pairings of hidden injury and betrayal: 子未, 丑午, 寅巳, 卯辰, 申亥, 酉戌.
相破：Destruction；拼音 xiāng pò；Six branch pairings of breakage and erosion: 子酉, 卯午, 辰丑, 未戌, 寅亥, 巳申.
